title: [Dev] Node-based `pre-commit` actions stopped working
body:
### Tested versions

`master` (295e465fe403954911ca75145cc5d21546274262)

### System information

macOS

### Issue description

I cannot use `pre-commit` anymore because of a 404 error.
I can work around the issue by removing the node based packages from the pre-commit file.

```
godot HEAD* ≡
 ❯ pre-commit
[INFO] Installing environment for local.
[INFO] Once installed this environment will be reused.
[INFO] This may take a few minutes...

return code: 1
stdout: (none)

                          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
      File "/nix/store/v21kg4vm7yy0wflh0avkibz0shk86jn8-python3-3.12.11/lib/python3.12/urllib/request.py", line 492, in _call_chain
```

### Steps to reproduce

- Install `pre-commit`
- Run `pre-commit` in the godot directory
